## Line 530

```plato

    // The three axis-aligned slabs of a box, one per world axis (X, Y, Z), each
    // spanning that axis' Min..Max coordinate. A point lies in the box exactly when
    // it lies in all three slabs, which is the standard slab reduction of a
    // ray/box or box/box test.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slab_method
    Slabs(b: Bounds3D): Array<Slab3D>
        => [Slab3D(Direction3D(Vector3D.UnitX), NumberInterval(b.Min.X, b.Max.X)),
            Slab3D(Direction3D(Vector3D.UnitY), NumberInterval(b.Min.Y, b.Max.Y)),
            Slab3D(Direction3D(Vector3D.UnitZ), NumberInterval(b.Min.Z, b.Max.Z))];
}
```
